local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage') local ok,err=pcall(function() local PS=require(RS.Shared.PortScene) PS.build({portId='london',portName='london',level=5,shipId='galleon',hasShipyard=true,facilities={'palace','bank','guild','harbormaster'},storyCount=0,companions={}},function() end) end) workspace:SetAttribute('ShotFov',55) return tostring(ok)..tostring(err)

local f=workspace:FindFirstChild("PortScene") assert(f,"PALACE_SCENE_MISSING")
local main=f:FindFirstChild("RoyalPalace") assert(main,"PALACE_MISSING")
local prim,models,meshes=0,0,0
for _,o in f:GetChildren() do
 local p=o:IsA("Model") and o:GetPivot().Position or (o:IsA("BasePart") and o.Position)
 if p and p.X<-240 and p.X>-640 and math.abs(p.Z)<300 then
  if o:IsA("Model") then models+=1 for _,d in o:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA("MeshPart") then meshes+=1 end end
  elseif o:IsA("BasePart") and o.Transparency<0.5 and not o:IsA("MeshPart") and o.Size.Y>1.5 then prim+=1 end
 end
end
-- [부속 건물 실물 확인] house()는 모델·모델 안 BasePart·기본 Part 상자 중 하나를 반환한다.
-- 모델 안 BasePart면 그 원본 모델 전체를, 폴더에 바로 놓인 Part면 기본 파츠 건물로 집계한다(이웃 건물 미포함).
local ann={}
for _,n in {"RoyalStable","RoyalGuardHouse","RoyalLibrary","RoyalAdministration","RoyalTower"} do
 local o=f:FindFirstChild(n,true)
 if not o then table.insert(ann,n.."=none") else
  local root,kind=o,"part-box"
  if o:IsA("Model") then kind="model" elseif o.Parent and o.Parent~=f and o.Parent:IsA("Model") then root,kind=o.Parent,"model-part" end
  local mp,bp,ids=0,0,{}
  local list=root:GetDescendants() if root:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(list,root) end
  for _,d in list do
   if d:IsA("MeshPart") then mp+=1 local id=tostring(d.MeshId):match("%d+") if id and #ids<2 and not table.find(ids,id) then table.insert(ids,id) end
   elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then bp+=1 end
  end
  table.insert(ann,string.format("%s=%s:%s mesh%d part%d [%s]",n,kind,root.Name,mp,bp,table.concat(ids,",")))
 end
end
local towers=0 for _,o in f:GetChildren() do if o.Name=="RoyalTower" then towers+=1 end end
return string.format("PALACE_AUDIT port=%s style=%s culture=%s tier=%s primitiveParts=%d models=%d meshParts=%d towers=%d | %s","london",tostring(main:GetAttribute("RoyalStyle")),tostring(main:GetAttribute("RoyalCulture")),tostring(main:GetAttribute("RoyalTier")),prim,models,meshes,towers,table.concat(ann,"; "))

 local p=o:IsA("Model") and o:GetPivot().Position or (o:IsA("BasePart") and o.Position)
 if p and p.X<-240 and p.X>-640 and math.abs(p.Z)<300 then
  if o:IsA("Model") then models+=1 for _,d in o:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA("MeshPart") then meshes+=1 end end
  elseif o:IsA("BasePart") and o.Transparency<0.5 and not o:IsA("MeshPart") and o.Size.Y>1.5 then prim+=1 end
 end
end
-- [부속 건물 실물 확인] house()는 모델·모델 안 BasePart·기본 Part 상자 중 하나를 반환한다.
-- 모델 안 BasePart면 그 원본 모델 전체를, 폴더에 바로 놓인 Part면 기본 파츠 건물로 집계한다(이웃 건물 미포함).
local ann={}
for _,n in {"RoyalStable","RoyalGuardHouse","RoyalLibrary","RoyalAdministration","RoyalTower"} do
 local o=f:FindFirstChild(n,true)
 if not o then table.insert(ann,n.."=none") else
  local root,kind=o,"part-box"
  if o:IsA("Model") then kind="model" elseif o.Parent and o.Parent~=f and o.Parent:IsA("Model") then root,kind=o.Parent,"model-part" end
  local mp,bp,ids=0,0,{}
  local list=root:GetDescendants() if root:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(list,root) end
  for _,d in list do
   if d:IsA("MeshPart") then mp+=1 local id=tostring(d.MeshId):match("%d+") if id and #ids<2 and not table.find(ids,id) then table.insert(ids,id) end
   elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then bp+=1 end
  end
  table.insert(ann,string.format("%s=%s:%s mesh%d part%d [%s]",n,kind,root.Name,mp,bp,table.concat(ids,",")))
 end
end
local towers=0 for _,o in f:GetChildren() do if o.Name=="RoyalTower" then towers+=1 end end
return string.format("PALACE_AUDIT port=%s style=%s culture=%s tier=%s primitiveParts=%d models=%d meshParts=%d towers=%d | %s","calicut",tostring(main:GetAttribute("RoyalStyle")),tostring(main:GetAttribute("RoyalCulture")),tostring(main:GetAttribute("RoyalTier")),prim,models,meshes,towers,table.concat(ann,"; "))
